# Data quality of `db17-r8-right-m16`

Motor m16, tested in the right position of R8.
Of 2 runs with 5 trials, 1 have warnings.
A warning means that the data should not be used for the quantities it affects, and a note states a limitation.

> [!WARNING]
> **1 of 2 runs have data that should not be used as it is.**
> - `R8-R-m16_C_b060p040_rep01-03_20261118`: imprecise LED timing, in 3 of 3 trials.

Each warning is given with its recommendation under its run below.

## Checks

| Check | Warning | Note |
|---|---|---|
| Angle scatter in steady parts over its pixel-based uncertainty, k (schema.md §9.6) | > 10 | > 5 |
| Usable frames (§9.2) | < 90 % | – |
| Frames dropped by the phone | – | > 5 % |
| Longest gap between frames, so ω is undetermined across it (§9.7) | > 46 ms | – |
| LED timing uncertainty σ_τ (§10.3) | > 10 ms | – |
| Trial aligned alone by its LED against the run's LED clock (§10.7), a warning when no event of the trial supports the run clock | > 10 ms | > 10 ms |
| Trial aligned alone by its motion against the run's motion clock, a warning when no event of the trial supports the run clock | > 0.1 s | > 0.1 s |
| Median motion against LED clock in the LED runs of the experiment | > 0.25 s | – |
| Usable frames faster than 50 rad/s | > 0.1 % | – |
| Steady frames at \|u\| ≥ 0.4 turning against the duty | > 5 % | – |
| Clock on the correlation of the schedule with ω alone, no departure from rest confirming it (§10.5) | always | – |
| Synchronised by motion, not the LED | – | always |
| Trial without a sync event of its own | – | always |

|---|---|
